occurrences.quote_span: Danish artist Jens Galschiøt installed his sculpture — called “The Orange Plague” — in the building in Strasbourg, France, on Tuesday.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Jens Galschiøt’s “The Orange Plague” sculpture

occurrences.quote_span: “Tomorrow I reveal the sculpture in the European Parliament. I hope it is well received and that it sparks a debate about friendship and power dynamics,” he wrote on social media.
occurrences.speaker: Jens Galschiøt
occurrences.subject: Jens Galschiøt’s “The Orange Plague” sculpture

occurrences.quote_span: Galschiøt, known for politically provocative art, wrote on his website that the work was inspired by Hans Christian Andersen’s “The Emperor’s New Clothes.”
occurrences.speaker: Jens Galschiøt
occurrences.subject: Jens Galschiøt’s “The Orange Plague” sculpture

occurrences.quote_span: Clausen said in a statement that no one should “accept living in fear and self-censorship” and that anyone “so thin-skinned that you cannot handle this sculpture being exhibited in the European Parliament, then you do not belong on the world stage.”
occurrences.speaker: Per Clausen
occurrences.subject: Jens Galschiøt’s “The Orange Plague” sculpture

occurrences.quote_span: A golden statue of a nude President Trump appeared inside the European Parliament as part of a two-day exhibition this week.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Jens Galschiøt’s “The Orange Plague” sculpture

occurrences.quote_span: He called the statue “a satirical outcry against Trump and the U.S. assault on the green transition and the rule-based world order.”
occurrences.speaker: Jens Galschiøt
occurrences.subject: Jens Galschiøt’s “The Orange Plague” sculpture

occurrences.checkable_against: Photographs and inspection of the sculpture
occurrences.quote_span: “Trump is depicted as a self-proclaimed King of Justice,” the artist continued. “He sits on the back of a frail man, holding a golf club next to a world-shaped golf ball in one hand, and scales symbolizing his power to define justice in the other hand.”
occurrences.speaker: Jens Galschiøt
